sessions.label: Practice 1
narrative: George Russell set the pace in Practice 1 with a 1:32.274.

Lewis Hamilton left the most time on the table: their fastest lap (1:32.773) was 0.265s slower than the theoretical lap built from their own best sectors (1:32.508), so there is more pace in the car than the lap time shows.
George Russell had the highest speed-trap reading, 303.0 km/h.

Context on George Russell's pace: “George Russell finished fastest in Free Practice 1 ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix, the Mercedes driver beating Charles Leclerc and Lando Norris to the top spot. The Briton posted a 1m 32.274s, leaving him 0.198s...” (— 2026 Singapore Grand Prix FP1 report and highlights: George Russell beats Charles Leclerc and Lando Norris to top spot i, Formula1.com).
